sloka: उपस्पृशंस्त्रिषवणं मधुमूलफलाशन: ।नायोध्यायै न राज्याय स्पृहये ऽद्य त्वया सह ॥ २.९५.१७॥
transliteration: upaspṛśaṁstriṣavaṇaṁ madhumūlaphalāśana: ।nāyodhyāyai na rājyāya spṛhaye 'dya tvayā saha ॥ 2.95.17॥

translations.english: Bathing thrice in your company at the time of prayers and partaking honey, roots and fruits, I do not yearn either for Ayodhya or for the kingdom.
